guide.priorLine: This official LALIGA account posts constantly about all clubs and both Spain/other national teams, so only a modest fraction of its output—mostly Barcelona player highlights, trophy/stat milestones, and throwback kit or bonding moments—actually centers on FC Barcelona, while the bulk covers Real Madrid, Atletico, other LaLiga clubs, national-team nostalgia, and app promos.

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Nostalgic Barcelona-kit or historic Barcelona moment throwback
examplesEnglish:
"First I went left, he did too. Then I went right, he did too. Then I went left again, and he went to buy a hot dog."

Iconic.

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Barcelona young talent's trophies/stats milestone graphic
examplesEnglish:
Since his debut... only 3 seasons ago.

and counting the World Cup 🏆

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Side-by-side then-vs-now or player duo comparison in Barcelona colors
examplesEnglish: What will we see from this young talent this season? 💫
Trained him to become world champion 🏆
Our most stylish player since he joined in '22

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Rival-club (mostly Real Madrid) birthday or player-highlight post
examplesEnglish:
The story's just begun 📖

Happy birthday, Thiago Pitarch!

offBeatPatterns.pattern: New signing presentation for a non-Barcelona club
examplesEnglish: A new duo entered the chat 👀

Career/manager retrospective for another club's figure
examplesEnglish: Before he trained Les Blues he won with the whites 🤍
